setup.media: two loopback H264 NVENC senders with decoding in a separate process
setup.excluded: viewer, DDS/SROS2, actual UI and WAN; no PNG/JSON/per-tick diagnostic snapshots in timed loop
setup.timing: host wall time including GPU completion needed by control; nested timers are inclusive and not additive

gpu_parity.scope: 12 dynamic actual-input comparisons. Separate frozen-state solve microbenchmark: serial/packed/packed/serial, 80 retained calls after20 warmups each block, CPU packing and GPU output wait included; excludes controller state preparation and Genesis/media.

gpu_sweep.scope: 200 deterministic perturbations of real frozen walking inputs; varied base/reference velocity,orientation,mass,inertia,use_mean,elapsed,full32bitkey,geometry,floor and search mask; each comparison starts from the same mean/key, separate from physics

clean_media_comparison.scope: mean of two means; each600steady steps, same protocol with separate launches

limits: Short gait validation does not prove long-duration/hardware behavior.
Timing varies with CPU/GPU contention and the loopback receiver shares the compute host.
Detailed nested timers add overhead; use clean runs for total-loop comparison.
CUDA frozen-state replay excludes Genesis/controller preparation; do not equate it with total-step speed.
Frozen-input comparisons check mathematical equivalence; the full Genesis body trajectories differed between revisions. Each short run still passed the pose/fault/stop checks.
Average and p95 remain distinct;10ms is the physics budget for each step, not an average deadline guarantee.
Focused canonical Go2/startup/readback gates passed; full required/extended/release suites were not rerun.
